issuer: the South Carolina Department of Motor Vehicles (SCDMV)
note: SCDMV's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives an 8-year licence at $25 and ID cards free from 17 ($15 from 5 to 16). The teenage drivers page says full driving privileges come at 17 (or after a year on a conditional or special restricted licence), so a full licence is kept from 17. The ID card page says a card is issued from five. The card's term wasn't read and is null.

sources.title: SCDMV, Fees
sources.said: 8-year License $25 ... ID Cards: 5 to 16 years old $15 ID Cards: 17 years of age or older (within a year or less of renewal cycle) Free

sources.title: SCDMV, Teenage Drivers
sources.said: You will earn full driving privileges at 17
